name: family-financial-board
description: Personal & Family Financial Management Dashboard - Full Stack Application

scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,emerald" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,emerald" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
